bounds.domain: One expired queued row, one authenticated owner snapshot, one final review-fence check and at most one provider effect.
limitations: The row was already reviewed and durably staged. Owner classes mean exact equality with the newly authenticated snapshot, a known difference, or an unavailable owner route. Final fence results are fresh, changed, or thrown. Calendar and reminder rows use this same admission projection.

An unavailable owner is within the existing retry window. A thrown final fence keeps a reminder queued; the Calendar journal pauses it as owner-unavailable. Retry bounds, storage faults, Undo, provider response loss, later receipt recovery and arbitrary rows remain outside this model. No unconditional progress or Android/device acceptance is claimed. A delivered call with a known changed owner pauses; an equal owner needs a fresh final fence before dispatch.

Conformance runs the actual Java coordinator and journal with controlled host ports. Strict expected-identity fences, owner rotation between authentication and the final check, repeated reconciliation and zero foreign effects are checked for both row kinds. This is bounded scenario conformance, not generated-trace equivalence or complete coordinator refinement.
